question: Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj organisation in 1875 at which of the following places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arya Samaj:-**

 
 
• **It is a Hindu reform movement that aims to promote monotheism and Vedic knowledge among Hindus and to eradicate social evils such as caste system, untouchability, child marriage, and dowry. **
 
• Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj organisation in 1875.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi:-**

 
 
• It was the place where the Indian National Army was founded in 1942, not Arya Samaj.
 
 
 
• **Amritsar:-**
 
 
• It is a holy city in Punjab that is known for the Golden Temple and the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
